scope: EXPLORATION ONLY - NOT hardware sign-off. One FPGA tile (GW1NZ-LV1QN48 lead, SNAP_MODE=fall) in the 20 MHz / <=16-tile chain. Interior values anchor to fitted nextpnr max-analysis numbers extracted into ../results/interior_delays.json; every exterior value (pads, TBUF en/dis, board hop) is SYNTHETIC because open-device datasheets (Gowin DS861) are not available and nextpnr offers no min analysis or IO timing model here.
voltage_temp: ambient, LVCMOS33 class assumption only (no datasheet applied)

delays_ns._comment_keys: each entry: [syn_min, fit, syn_max]. fit = fitted-interior anchor where noted + synthetic exterior; signatures of sources recorded in machine.json
delays_ns._t_do_int_src: fit: 0.46 clk2q + ~1.0 logic/route class from fitted crit report; syn_max: fitted crit total 3.93 (max-analysis, widest interior claim); syn_min: synthetic 0.3x-class bound, nextpnr has no min analysis
delays_ns._t_bw_int_src: same class as t_do_int (FF clk-to-q + routed logic to B_W flag, interior)
delays_ns._t_latcho_src: latch OR + forward comb interior; fit anchored on fitted LUT-chain class (cross report shows 1.03 ns LUT4 stage), no direct fitted path exists - labelled partial-anchor
delays_ns._t_tbuf_src: synthetic TBUF enable/disable/propagate, unknown-by-default; compare discrete rev-A 2G125/2G126 ten/tdis max 5.1-5.7 ns (datasheet real; FPGA pad lib has no open model here)
delays_ns._t_xdom_req_src: first-shift special-load recovery requirement: latch-clocked shadow FF -> clk-clocked shreg. fit/syn_max = fitted 4.86 ns (nextpnr max) + 0.04 setup = 4.9; syn_min = synthetic slack exploration bound (min delays unbounded in the tool)
delays_ns._t_snap_src: SYNTHETIC placeholder for the shadow-FF setup/hold window at the latch falling edge (analogue of 74x165 /PL recovery); UNSIGNED - no device STA exists here
delays_ns._t_clkhi_src: synthetic min high/low pulse guard band for the fabric shift clock; the 20 MHz binding constraint is the W-switch containment, this only rejects degenerate duty
delays_ns._route_hop_src: SYNTHETIC connector-pair + short trace hop, unknown-by-default; 1.5 matches the discrete timing-chain synthetic hop for cross-family comparison; NOT a field-solved value

fit.note: fitted interior anchors + mid synthetic exterior; reference corner

syn_max.note: slowest exploration; interior = fitted max-analysis anchors

controller_fixed.note: 20 MHz shift clock at the controller, 200 ns latch pulse; guard/lead/high-phase swept separately
